title: Cold rebuild: lag and start offsets
summary: Rebuild Lag and StartOffset from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You wrote **Lag and where a consumer starts** in *Consumer groups, rebalancing and lag*.
Now write it again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the
ones you passed the first time.
Why these two? They answer the questions you get on every Kafka incident: "how far behind are we?" and "why did the
new deployment skip (or replay) everything?". Pulling them out of memory is what makes them stay there.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Retention has moved the log start of a partition past the group's committed offset. What does this print?
code: var valid = committed >= logStart && committed <= logEnd;
explain: Offsets 400 to 999 were deleted by retention, so the committed offset is out of range and `auto.offset.reset`
decides. With `earliest` the consumer jumps to the log start; those 600 records are gone for this group.
